title: Clopen projection and a composite derived counit cancel the direct-image unit
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $q:X\to W$ be a morphism of schemes, let $s:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion which is also a closed immersion, and put $r=qs$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $P_u\dashv S_u$ for exact inverse image and total derived direct image, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$. Let $J_s\dashv P_s$ be exact open extension with identity-on-open unit $u_s:1\xrightarrow{\sim}P_sJ_s$ [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Let $t_s:J_s\to S_s$ be the $P_s\dashv S_s$ adjunct of $u_s^{-1}:P_sJ_s\to1$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Let $\pi_s:F\to J_sP_sF$ be the morphism which is identity on $s(U)$ and zero on its complementary open, defined on sheaves and applied degreewise. Let $c:S_qS_s\xrightarrow{\sim}S_r$ be the direct-image compositor conjugate to $P_sP_q\cong P_r$, using the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], and put $a=c\circ S_q(t_s):S_qJ_s\to S_r$.
Then $t_s$ and $a$ are isomorphisms and $(t_sP_s)\pi_s=\eta_s$. For every unbounded derived object $M$ on $U$, put $H=S_rM$. After the canonical identification $P_sP_qH\cong P_rH$, the following composite equals $1_H$:
$$H\xrightarrow{\eta_{q,H}}S_qP_qH\xrightarrow{S_q(\pi_{s,P_qH})}S_qJ_sP_sP_qH\xrightarrow{S_qJ_s(\varepsilon_{r,M})}S_qJ_sM\xrightarrow{a_M}S_rM=H.$$
The assertion is natural in $M$ and uses the specified maps in the derived category itself. No properness or boundedness hypothesis on $q,M$ is imposed, and no projection-formula morphism is involved.

proof.text: Use the existing invertible canonical sheaf comparison sheafComparison: s_! ≅ s_* already used in the definition of reverseSheafAdjunction. Let α identify upperStar with open restriction, let a be extension by zero adjoint to restriction, and let b be restriction adjoint to direct image. The published identity a.unit ≫ restriction.map(comparison) = inv(b.counit), together with compatibility of α with the counits of its two adjunctions, shows that the counit of reverseSheafAdjunction is the inverse of the specified open-extension unit. This is the private lemma sheaf_counit; no product-category model is needed.

proof.text: For an exact adjunction whose counit is invertible, compare its localized counit with the inverse derived-composition comparison followed by the localized counit isomorphism and the derived-identity comparison. Evaluate on cochain representatives. The localization counit formula, natural-isomorphism factorization, derived-composition factorization and the derived-identity formula cancel the comparison isomorphisms. This proves the private lemma exact_counit. Apply it to the reverse sheaf adjunction and the equality from Step 1 to obtain derived_counit: its counit is exactly openUnit.inv.

proof.text: The inverse Hom equivalence sends the canonical rightAdjointUniq isomorphism to the counit of the reverse derived adjunction. Step 2 therefore identifies this isomorphism with the specified comparison, which was independently defined as the adjunct of openUnit.inv. It is invertible. The standard unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom equation gives projector followed by comparison whiskered with pullback equal to adjunction.unit. Functoriality then gives invertibility of compositeComparison.

proof.text: Let H = S_r M and e = d.hom_H followed by ε_r,M, retaining the actual pullback compositor d. Naturality of comparison at e moves it across J_s(e). Replace projector followed by comparison with η_s using Step 3. Naturality of directComposition moves it across (S_s ⋙ S_q)(e). The resulting initial pair η_q followed by S_q(η_s) is the unit of the composite adjunction.

proof.text: Apply unit_conjugateEquiv to the composite adjunction, the adjunction for r, and d.inv. It identifies the composite unit followed by directComposition at P_s P_q H with η_r,H followed by S_r(d.inv_H). Functoriality combines d.inv_H with e; inverse cancellation leaves ε_r,M. The whole expression is η_r,H followed by S_r(ε_r,M), hence the identity by the right triangle identity. This proves exactly the specified cancellation, without properness, boundedness, or a projection-formula assumption. All transformations are natural; empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring require no exception.
